newsitem.title: USA: Eckler signs to combine with Smart Choice.
newsitem.headline: Eckler signs to combine with Smart Choice.

text.p: Eckler Industries Inc said Tuesday that it has signed a letter of intent to merge with Smart Choice Holdings Inc, a privately held company organized to consolidate automobile industry companies.
Eckler said it will make the combination by issuing 6.5 million common shares in exchange for all of Smart Choice stock.
Smart Choice operations will include four divisions -- Corvette parts and accessories, new car sales, used car sales and insurance and auto finance, Eckler said.
Eckler, which supplies Corvette parts and accessories, said the combined public company would be headquartered in Titusville, Fla.
